senses.definition_en: a person of little or no consequence; a nobody; a nonentity; an absolute zero

examples.english: Apparently, the President of the Republic [of Chile] holds almost dictatorial powers; but, constitutionally speaking, he is of little consequence.
examples.ref: 1888, Julio Bañados Espinosa, Gobierno parlamentario y sistema representativo, Imprenta Cervantes, page 59:
examples.text: En apariencias, el Presidente de la República está revestido de poderes casi dictatoriales; pero, constitucionalmente hablando, es un cero a la izquierda.
examples.translation: Apparently, the President of the Republic [of Chile] holds almost dictatorial powers; but, constitutionally speaking, he is of little consequence.

examples.english: The objective of the conference is to announce the psychosocial and labor rehabilitation that Morea achieved. ‘With treatment, the ill can lead a dignified life and be useful to society and not a nobody as until now’, stated its president, Angeles Fernández.
examples.ref: 2008 November 6, “Más de 300 enfermos mentales se han rehabilitado en Morea”, in La Región:
examples.text: El objetivo de las jornadas es dar a conocer la rehabilitación psicosocial y laboral que realiza Morea. ‘Con tratamiento, los enfermos pueden llevar una vida digna y ser útiles a la sociedad y no un cero a la izquierda como hasta ahora’, afirmó su presidenta, Angeles Fernández.
examples.translation: The objective of the conference is to announce the psychosocial and labor rehabilitation that Morea achieved. ‘With treatment, the ill can lead a dignified life and be useful to society and not a nobody as until now’, stated its president, Angeles Fernández.

glosses: a person of little or no consequence; a nobody; a nonentity; an absolute zero

senses.definition_en: lie (especially malicious), canard

examples.english: Let's see if you can clear up the lie for me.
examples.ref: 1890, Emilia Pardo Bazán, La prueba, chapter 2:
examples.text: A ver si me aclaras el infundio.
examples.translation: Let's see if you can clear up the lie for me.

examples.english: Let no one be fooled by the Associated Press's lies. Lies are lies and the truth is the truth.
examples.ref: 1988, Juan Bosch, Viaje a los antípodas:
examples.text: Que nadie se deje engañar por los infundios de la Associated Press. Los infundios son infundios y la verdad es la verdad.
examples.translation: Let no one be fooled by the Associated Press's lies. Lies are lies and the truth is the truth.

examples.english: … a journalist echoed another fib: that Polanco had said "Spain doesn't have the balls" to deny him a television.
examples.text: [...] un periodista se hizo eco de otro infundio: que Polanco había dicho que "no había cojones en España" para negarle una televisión.
examples.translation: … a journalist echoed another fib: that Polanco had said "Spain doesn't have the balls" to deny him a television.

glosses: lie (especially malicious), canard

senses.definition_en: cruise ship, cruiser (a passenger ship used for pleasure voyages, where the voyage itself and the ship's amenities are considered an essential part of the experience)

examples.english: Cruise ships bring 4% of visitors to the city and 13% of the tourist tax revenue, he adds as a message to Jaume Collboni's government, although he also offers CLIA to "collaborate with Barcelona" if the sector causes any congestion.
examples.ref: 2023 December 4, Clara Blanchar, Dani Cordero, “Barcelona supera este año los tres millones de cruceristas, y aumentan solo los que hacen escala”, in El País:
examples.text: Los cruceros aportan el 4% de visitantes de la ciudad y un 13% de la recaudación de la tasa turística, añade como recado al gobierno de Jaume Collboni, aunque también ofrece a CLIA para “colaborar con Barcelona” si el sector provoca alguna congestión.
examples.translation: Cruise ships bring 4% of visitors to the city and 13% of the tourist tax revenue, he adds as a message to Jaume Collboni's government, although he also offers CLIA to "collaborate with Barcelona" if the sector causes any congestion.

glosses: cruise ship, cruiser (a passenger ship used for pleasure voyages, where the voyage itself and the ship's amenities are considered an essential part of the experience)
